# Parameters

## <a id="cart.max-quantity"></a> max_quantity

- Value: 10
- Unit: pieces
- Configurable: no
- Rationale: a shelf holds ten pieces.

## <a id="cart.sizes"></a> sizes

- Configurable: no
- Rationale: carts come in two sizes.

The sizes of a cart.

| size | slots |
| --- | --- |
| small | 5 |
| large | 20 |
